title: Expected distribution
view: Shared front-view base (visuals/distribution_bases/front): skeleton on the left, grey body on the right, patient's right on the image left; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A lateral TAP block numbs the anterior abdominal wall below the umbilicus on one side.
claims: Skin: anterior abdominal wall below the umbilicus (T10) to above the groin crease (T12), from the midline to about the anterior axillary line; a graded top border at the umbilicus.
Not shaded: the upper abdomen (needs a subcostal approach), the flank (lateral cutaneous branches leave at the mid-axillary line) and the groin (L1, inconsistent) (record anatomy; NYSORA).
Right-sided block, patient's right on the image left (house laterality); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
